procedural_matters: The initiator (International Jury) was represented by Angela Stenger.
ITA 54 was represented by Tommaso Zummo.
facts: During Vaurien Race 4 a jury boat was positioned right below the finishing line.
ITA 54 touched the pinned mark with the port side of her hull, her centerboard got entangled with the anchor line of the mark and after that the helm touched the mark several times with his hand.
ITA 54 dit not take any penalty.
conclusions: ITA 54 touched the finish mark and broke RRS 31.
By knowingly breaking rule 31 and not taking the appropriate penalty, ITA 54 failed to compete in compliance with the principles of sportsmanship and fair play. ITA 54 broke RRS 2.
decision: ITA 54 is scored DNE in Race 4.
